description: Owner only: needs the office access code (bo_live_...) as Bearer; a bot link (bi_...) does not get this tool. Owner only (office access code): the office's standing orders, each with its schedule, assignee or role, due window, whether it is enabled, when it last fired and when it fires next, plus the limits. Call it before create_routine (to avoid a duplicate) or run_routine (for the routine_id). Same as GET /v1/workspaces/:id/routines. Example: {} (no arguments).
name: list_routines
title: List routines
